content.text:
Contract research with company ownership is acceptable per my hard limits. However, I want university ownership (uni_owns_option_to_licence or similar). Let me check - my open_to includes contract_research, so the engagement type is fine. But my interests say "university ownership of results."

For contract research, the standard is company_owns. But my interests say university ownership. I should push back on IP ownership - propose uni_owns_option_to_licence instead, and reduce exclusivity from 18 to 12 months as a trade.

Change 1: ip from contract_research_company_owns to uni_owns_option_to_licence
Change 2: exclusivity months from 18 to 12
I'll keep the exclusivity field breadth (pharmaceutical and food) intact while trimming the months, trading that concession for university ownership of results.
